- #4812 (EV charger bay conflicts, Mar 2025): Vantorre Mobility.
- #PD-4402 (Quillfeather Outfitters): different account.
- The Moss digests on 10 Mar 2025, 7 Jul 2025, 1 Dec 2025, 3 May 2026 and 3 Aug 2026 mention Group issues but give no ticket number.

Sources are the channel posts and Moss digest files named above. Nothing here came from a direct message.
